query: Three charges q1 = q2 = q3 = -2 * 10^-7 C are placed at the 3 vertices of an equilateral triangle with side length 15 cm. Calculate the net electric force acting on q3.

A heavy object is suspended by a string from the ceiling of a train car moving at a constant velocity. The object can be considered a simple pendulum with a natural oscillation period of T0 = 1.0 s. The train is jolted when it passes over the rail joints. It is observed that the object oscillates most strongly when the train's speed is 45 km/h. Calculate the length of the rail segments (or the distance between rail joints).

Initially, a support is used to hold an object at the position where the spring is undeformed. The object has a mass of 500g and the spring has k = 40 N/m. The support is then moved downwards with an acceleration a = 2 m/s2. Calculate the amplitude of the object's oscillation. Use g = 10 m/s2.
An object undergoes simple harmonic motion with its position given by x = 5 cos(pi*t + pi/3). What is the maximum distance the object can travel in a time interval of 1.5 seconds?
A force F = 0.8 cos(5t - pi/2) N acts on an object of mass m = 400 g undergoing simple harmonic motion. What is the amplitude of the object's oscillation?

An object is dropped from rest, with g = 10 m/s2. After some time, the object hits the ground. The distance the object falls in the last 1 second is twice the distance it falls in the second immediately preceding it. From what height was the object dropped?

A stone is dropped from the mouth of a deep cave down to the bottom. After 4 seconds from the moment it was dropped, the sound of the stone hitting the bottom is heard. Calculate the depth of the cave. Given the speed of sound in air is 330 m/s. Take g = 9.8 m/s2.

A plane mirror stands on the floor, tilted backward by an angle $\\alpha = 30$ degrees with respect to the vertical. What is the maximum distance a person of height $h = 1.7$ m can stand from the edge of the mirror and still see a portion of their own image? Neglect the distance from the eye to the top of the head.
R = 40 ohm and the resonance frequency is f0 = 60 Hz. The current is halved when f = 120 Hz. Determine the inductive reactance Z_L at resonance f0.

Charges q1 = -12 x 10^-6 C and q2 = 2.5 x 10^-6 C are placed at points A and B, respectively, which are 15 cm apart in air. Calculate the magnitude of the resultant electric field E at point C. Given that AC = 20 cm and BC = 5 cm.

At the three vertices of a right-angled triangle ABC (with the right angle at A), which has side lengths BC = 50 cm, AC = 40 cm, and AB = 30 cm, charges q1 = q2 = q3 = 10^-9 C are placed. Determine the magnitude of the electric field at point H, which is the foot of the altitude drawn from vertex A.

Two point charges q1 = 2 x 10^-2 uC and q2 = -2 x 10^-2 uC are placed at points A and B, separated by a distance a = 30 cm, in air. What is the magnitude of the electric field strength at point M, which is equidistant from A and B by a distance equal to a?

Two point charges, q1 = 8 x 10^-8 C and q2 = -8 x 10^-8 C, are placed at points A and B in air. The distance AB is 4 cm. Find the magnitude of the electric field vector at point C, which is on the perpendicular bisector of AB and is 2 cm away from AB.

Two charges, q1 = 6 * 10^-8 C and q2 = -6 * 10^-8 C, are placed at points A and B in air, 8 cm apart. A third charge, q3 = 6 * 10^-8 C, is placed at point C, with CA = 5 cm and CB = 3 cm. Determine the force acting on q3.

Two point charges q1 = 10^-8 C and q2 = -3*10^-8 C are placed in air at two points A and B, 8 cm apart. A point charge q = 10^-8 C is placed at point M, which is on the perpendicular bisector of the line segment AB and 3 cm away from AB. Given k = 9*10^9 N.m^2/C^2. What is the magnitude of the net electric force exerted by q1 and q2 on q?

Three charges q1 = +3 uC, q2 = -2 uC, and q3 = +1 uC are placed on a straight line in the order q1, q2, q3, with adjacent charges separated by 10 cm. Calculate the magnitude of the net force acting on q2.

Three charges, q1 = 8*10^-9 C, q2 = q3 = -8*10^-9 C, are placed at the three vertices of an equilateral triangle ABC with side length a = 6 cm, in air. Determine the net force acting on a charge q0 = 6*10^-9 C placed at the center O of the triangle.

Two electric charges, q1 = +8 * 10^-8 C and q2 = +8 * 10^-8 C, are placed at two points A and B, separated by 6 cm in the air. A third charge, q3 = -8 * 10^-8 C, is placed at point C. Given that the distance from C to A is 8 cm and from C to B is 3 cm. Calculate the net electric force acting on q3.

Two charges, q1 = -2 * 10^-8 C and q2 = -2 * 10^-8 C, are placed at points A and B, which are 6 cm apart. A test charge q = 10^-6 C is placed at point M, which is located on the perpendicular bisector of AB, 4 cm away from the line segment AB.

Two electric charges q1 = +1 * 10^-6 C and q2 = -1 * 10^-6 C are placed at two points A and B, separated by 10 cm. A third electric charge q3 = +1 * 10^-6 C is placed at the midpoint of AB. Calculate the electric force acting on q3.
Three electric charges q1 = q2 = q3 = +9 * 10^-7 C are placed at the 3 vertices of an equilateral triangle with a side length of 12 cm. Calculate the net electric force acting on q3.
Three electric charges, q1 = q2 = q3 = -1 * 10^-6 C, are placed at the three vertices of an equilateral triangle with a side length of 12 cm. Calculate the resultant electric force acting on q3.
Three electric charges, q1 = q2 = q3 = -8 * 10^-8 C, are placed at the three vertices of an equilateral triangle with a side length of 12 cm. Determine the net electric force exerted on q3.

Two charges, q1 = +8 * 10^-8 C and q2 = -8 * 10^-8 C, are placed at points A and B, 10 cm apart. A test charge q = 10^-8 C is placed at point M, which lies on the perpendicular bisector of AB, 5 cm away from AB. Calculate the resultant electric force acting on q.

Three charges q1 = +2 uC, q2 = +2 uC, and q3 = -2 uC are placed at the three vertices of an equilateral triangle with a side length of 10 cm. Calculate the magnitude of the net electric force acting on q3.

In a vacuum, two charges q1 = 10^-7 C and q2 = -10^-7 C are placed at points A and B, separated by 8 cm. Determine the resultant force acting on a third charge q0 = 10^-7 C when q0 is placed at point M, 4 cm from A and 12 cm from B.

Two point charges, q1 = 6 x 10^-6 C and q2 = -6 x 10^-6 C, are placed in air at points A and B, separated by 10 cm. A charge q3 = -3 x 10^-8 C is placed at point C, where AC = BC = 12 cm. Calculate the magnitude of the electric force exerted on q3 by q1 and q2.

Two charges q1 = -8 * 10^-7 C and q2 = -9 * 10^-7 C are placed at points A and B, respectively, 12 cm apart in air. A charge q3 = +7 * 10^-7 C is placed at point C, such that the distance from C to A is 6 cm and from C to B is 6 cm. Calculate the net electric force acting on q3.

Two point charges q1 = +5 * 10^-8 C and q2 = +6 * 10^-8 C are placed at points A and B, respectively, 15 cm apart in air. A third charge q3 = -7 * 10^-8 C is placed at point C, such that the distance from C to A is 3 cm and the distance from C to B is 17 cm. Calculate the net electric force acting on q3.

Two point charges q1 and q2 are placed at A and B, with AB = 2 cm. Given that q1 + q2 = 7 x 10^-8 C. At point M, which is 6 cm from q1 and 8 cm from q2, the net electric field strength is E = 0. Find q2.

At three vertices of a square with side length a = 40cm, three equal positive point charges (q1 = q2 = q3 = 5 x 10^-9 C) are placed. What is the magnitude of the electric field vector at the fourth vertex of the square?

Four points A, B, C, D in air form a rectangle ABCD with sides AD = 3 cm and AB = 4 cm. Charges q1, q2, q3 are placed at A, B, and C respectively. Given q2 = -12.5 x 10^-8 C and q3 = -6.4 x 10^-8 C. Let vector E2 be the electric field vector produced by q2 at point D, and let vector E13 be the resultant electric field vector produced by q1 and q3 at point D. If vector E2 = vector E13, determine q1.

A thin circular ring with a radius R = 5 cm carries a total charge Q = 3 uC, uniformly distributed along its circumference. The ring lies in the xy-plane, centered at the origin. Calculate the magnitude of the electric field at point P located on the z-axis, 2.5 cm from the center.

Two electric charges, q1 = -3 * 10^-8 C and q2 = -6 * 10^-8 C, are placed at points A and B, separated by 17 cm in the air. A third charge, q3 = +3 * 10^-8 C, is placed at point C. Given that the distance from C to A is 8 cm and the distance from C to B is 9 cm. Calculate the net electric force acting on q3.

Two point charges, q1 = -8 * 10^-8 C and q2 = -2 * 10^-8 C, are placed at points A and B, 14 cm apart, in the air. A third charge, q3 = -7 * 10^-8 C, is placed at point C, such that the distance from C to A is 10 cm and the distance from C to B is 7 cm. Calculate the net electric force acting on q3.

Two charges, q1 = +2 * 10^-8 C and q2 = -2 * 10^-8 C, are placed at two points A and B, separated by 10 cm. A third charge, q3 = -2 * 10^-8 C, is placed at the midpoint of AB. Calculate the electric force acting on q3.

Three identical charges, q = -7 * 10^-6 C, are placed at the three vertices of an isosceles right-angled triangle with equal sides of length a = 12 cm. Calculate the net force acting on the charge located at the right-angle vertex.
Three electric charges, q1 = q2 = q3 = -9 * 10^-8 C, are placed at the three vertices of an equilateral triangle with a side length of 10 cm in air. Calculate the net electric force exerted on q3.

In a series RLC circuit, at angular frequency omega_0, the inductor has inductive reactance X_L = 28 ohm and the capacitor has capacitive reactance X_C = 112 ohm. By what multiple of omega_0 should the angular frequency be changed to achieve resonance?

Circuit AB consists of segment AM, which has resistor R1 = 10 ohm in series with capacitor C, and segment MB, which has resistor R2 = 90 ohm in series with inductor L. Given that L*C*omega^2 = 1 and u_AM is 90 degrees out of phase with u_MB. An RMS voltage U = 100 V is applied across AB. What is the total power consumed by circuit AB?

Consider an AB circuit with R1 = 30 ohm and R2 = 40 ohm, satisfying L*C*omega^2 = 1, where u_AM is in quadrature with u_MB. The total power consumed by the entire circuit when a voltage U = 100 V is applied across AB is 142.86 W. If the same voltage is applied across the MB segment (R2 + L), what is the power consumed by MB?
An AC circuit has XL = 25 ohm, XC = 100 ohm, R = 40 ohm, and U = 120 V. If the frequency is doubled, what is the power consumed by resistor R?
In a circuit, XL = 40 ohm, XC = 160 ohm, R = 60 ohm, U = 180 V. If the frequency f is doubled, what is the power dissipated across R?
In an AC circuit, XL = 20 ohm, XC = 80 ohm, R = 30 ohm, and the applied voltage U = 150 V. If the frequency is doubled, what is the power dissipated by R?

At the three vertices of a right triangle (right-angled at A), with side lengths a = 50 cm, b = 40 cm, c = 30 cm, charges q1 = q2 = q3 = 10^-9 C are placed. Determine the magnitude of the electric field at point H, where H is the foot of the altitude dropped from vertex A.

Two point charges, q1 = +3 * 10^-9 C and q2 = -3 * 10^-9 C, are placed at two points A and B, separated by 4 cm. Calculate the magnitude of the electric field strength at point M, which is located on the perpendicular bisector of AB, at a distance of 3 cm from the midpoint of AB.

Two electric charges q1 = +2 * 10^-8 C and q2 = +2 * 10^-8 C are placed at two points A and B, separated by 8 cm. Calculate the magnitude of the electric field at point M, which lies on the perpendicular bisector of AB and is 6 cm away from AB.

Two charges q1 = +9 * 10^-7 C and q2 = -9 * 10^-7 C are placed at two points A and B, separated by 10 cm. A third charge q3 = -9 * 10^-7 C is placed at the midpoint of AB. Calculate the electric force acting on q3.

Two electric charges, q1 = +8 * 10^-6 C and q2 = -8 * 10^-6 C, are placed at points A and B, separated by 6 cm. A test charge q = 10^-8 C is placed at point M, which is on the perpendicular bisector of AB and is 3 cm away from the line segment AB. Calculate the net electric force acting on the charge q.
Three electric charges, q1 = q2 = q3 = -1 * 10^-7 C, are placed at the three vertices of an equilateral triangle with a side length of 10 cm. Calculate the resultant electric force acting on q3.

Two electric charges, q1 = +5 * 10^-7 C and q2 = -5 * 10^-7 C, and a third charge q = 10^-8 C. Charges q1 and q2 are placed at points A and B, 10 cm apart. The test charge q is placed at point M, which lies on the perpendicular bisector of the line segment AB, 5 cm away from AB. Calculate the net electric force acting on q.

Two point charges, q1 = +4 * 10^-6 C and q2 = -4 * 10^-6 C, are located at points A and B, separated by 8 cm. A third charge, q3 = -4 * 10^-6 C, is placed at the midpoint of AB. Calculate the net electric force acting on q3.

Two point charges q1 = +7 * 10^-6 C and q2 = -7 * 10^-6 C are placed at points A and B, separated by 6 cm. A third point charge q3 = +7 * 10^-6 C is placed at the midpoint of AB. Calculate the electric force acting on q3.
Three electric charges q1 = q2 = q3 = -2 * 10^-6 C are placed at the 3 vertices of an equilateral triangle with side length 15 cm. Calculate the resultant electric force acting on q3.
